action_scope: Full45D-input actor fine-tuning, not bounded residual adaptation. Original joint action scales/clips and rough contact/tilt termination configuration retained; no residual envelope. Separate method/resource comparison.
training_data: Fixed2flat+3rough101+3rough107 tile columns,128 environments. No imported old replay/teacher. Actor warmstart only, fresh critic/optimizer, explicit std.2. All vector rows charged before physics, failure batches conservatively uncertain.
selection: Final checkpoint after exactly128 PPO updates only; intermediate checkpoints preserved but not selected. No automatic resume or retry of failed attempt. Source/base hashes before/after checked.
evaluation: After training report complete, freeze final policy and original base on identical new seed229 phase-local starts. Each policy/terrain5x2000 and2x1000 flat. Training reward not used to declare qualification.
acceptance: Pilot supports further work only with paired task gain and eligible flat retention. Stable goal requires>=9/10 per terrain across independent training runs, repeated positive gains and new-terrain/gait evidence. One pilot is insufficient.
retention_rule: Full1000-step windows,750steady samples, no fall/reset/safety violation; meanXY<=max(1.1*base,base+.005), eachX/Y<=base+.01 m/s.
failure_policy: Retain every failed attempt, trajectory and charged/uncertain cost. Never promote aborted final state or select earlier best checkpoint after seeing evaluation. No replacement starts.
limits: New larger-budget method; not evidence of equal-budget superiority over prior online residual methods.
history_contract: Clip only emitted command before env.step; keep original request for PPO log probability. Assert every next actor/critic action-history slice equals emitted command, or zero after reset.
cost_review: New524288 training budget plus48000 evaluation; retain parent524288 spent and retire its unused evaluation budget. No checkpoint or replay imported from incompatible parent.
